status.detail: Fork PR 233 resolved review threads but the final review found two architectural blockers; build is blocked by an unrelated C4819 encoding failure.
status.label: Review drafted — blockers found

proposed_comments.body: Use immutable fallback label snapshots tagged with the query generation so a slower earlier response cannot overwrite the first-paint result for a newer query.
proposed_comments.title: Tag fallback label snapshots by query generation

proposed_comments.body: Avoid making newer queries wait behind a blocking RPC gate. A hung extension can otherwise prevent all subsequent queries from completing; prefer cancellation or generation-aware result suppression.
proposed_comments.title: Do not serialize RPCs behind a blocking gate
